name: Thread & Connection
description: Visual metaphors for connection, structure, and the thread that runs through life — braided ropes, webs, spiraling paths.

assets.alt: A tightly braided rope showing intertwined strands
assets.caption: Every thread tells a story when you follow it far enough.

assets.alt: An intricate spiderweb glistening with fine detail
assets.caption: Connections too fine to see — until you look.

assets.alt: A spiral staircase viewed from above, descending into depth
assets.caption: The deeper you go, the more the pattern reveals itself.
